description_en: Retries all failed data sources in a specified folder and its subfolders in batch
description_zh: 批量重试指定目录及其子目录下的所有失败数据源
name: RetryDirectoryFailedSources

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this value explicitly by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise knowledge base folder. Failed resources in the folder and its subfolders are included recursively
parameters.help_zh: 企业知识库目录 ID（递归包含子目录下的失败资源）
parameters.name: directory_id
